verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak banner structure. The eyebrow '24 HOURS, 24 / READERS' breaks awkwardly and is set so large it competes with the headline. The legal line is crammed into an unreadably small column at the far right. The book cover is pushed against the top and left edges, and the logo, eyebrow and body copy sit in staggered blocks that share no edge. A is slightly worse because its body copy leaves 'night.' alone on the last line. B wraps the body copy into three balanced lines, but its CTA is smaller and floats further from the copy it belongs to.
